RESEARCH

Research

Technical notes on papers, implementation and evaluation.

Development history

The training record documents 300 epochs from random initialization on COCO 2017, without external pretrained weights. The architecture follows YOLO26m. The original model and training source identify portions adapted from the Ultralytics implementation under AGPL-3.0.

Two detection paths

The NMS variant suppresses overlapping boxes by intersection over union. The NMS-free variant ranks candidate positions and class scores in two stages. Testing both on the same data makes their end-to-end behaviour observable.

Paper note · YOLO

The original YOLO paper predicts locations and classes from the whole image in one network evaluation. For a comparison of current implementations, candidate selection and post-processing also belong in the timing protocol.

Redmon et al. · You Only Look Once ↗

Experiments and interpretation

Training used 116,287 train2017 images. A separate 2,000-image development split was used for epoch selection. Final evaluation used the 5,000 val2017 images. The historical evaluation and the distribution ONNX evaluation differ in resize rules, numerical precision and candidate selection for NMS.
